main.about:
A curious guy who really gets into it once he gets a grasp of whatever he's doing
Hi, I'm Manu. Programming technician who really likes python. I like coding in projects of any size and especially seeing the results: a nice, working and efficient program that does what it's supposed to do. Once I've warmed up to everybody things usually go smoothly. I got into code and programming in high school, mostly through small stuff like videogame mods, Windows scripts and IT assignments. In 2022 I tried informatics engineering, taking it up a notch. Since then I've dabbled in Lua, Python and Bash for recreation (mostly reading already written code, understanding it, and modifying it to suit my needs). My favourite pastimes are listening to music (mostly game OSTs, EDM and nu metal), playing and modding games (mostly PAYDAY 2 and Source games), reading manga or sometimes rewatching old movies.

projects.skyfall:
PROJECT SKYFALL
A Programming II assignment back in 2023 when I was still doing engineering. It's a simple CLI RPG made in Python, code features OOP and use of constants. In game you can choose class/spawnpoint, fight, spend experience points and check/use items in inventory. Was planned to have dialogue, story and an item shop, but couldn't implement them in time. This was the first time I experienced crunch, a bless and a curse.
